titulo: A DANÇA QUE O PAI ENSAIOU
personagens: Bruna, a bride around 28 with dark wavy hair in an updo and a simple white wedding dress; her father, a man around 60 with gray hair and a gray suit; Bruna's sister, a woman around 32 with a short bob and a green dress
cenario: a family home and a festive wedding reception hall with a small band and a curtain
cenas: At the wedding reception, Bruna turning toward a curtain as a shoe taps on the floor behind it
Bruna's father nervously avoiding the dance floor at a school party in a memory scene
Bruna finding a dance class receipt in her father's suit jacket pocket at home, puzzled
Bruna holding the receipt, wondering who the present was for
At the ceremony, the father asking the band to pause and pointing to a screen
Home scene of the father practicing simple dance steps in the living room with Bruna's sister
The guests watching the screen, curious and smiling
The father stepping out from behind the curtain and reaching his hand to Bruna, emotional
Bruna and her father dancing freely in the center of the hall while guests clap
Close-up of the father and daughter laughing together in a warm embrace on the dance floor
